text:
[Council File 26-1347]
Motion (Harris-Dawson – Jurado) relative to actions and resources required to implement interim facility bed matching for City funded interim beds if there is a dissolution of the Los Angeles Homelessness Services Authority and a split between the City and the County.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Homelessness and Health Committee action: Approved as Amended: ADOPTED Motion (Harris-Dawson – Jurado) dated September 22, 2026 AS AMENDED BY Motion (Jurado - Padilla) (Nov 10, 2026)
